description: Backend capability registry baseline (plan todo 16, design 9.1). Each entry declares one layer's capability claims; effective_capability intersects engine/adapter/deployment; probe receipts gate enablement (empty = unprobed = not enabled, never optimistic). Native xTB PATH and ORCA-calling-xTB are separate entries with distinct constraint semantics; xTB PATH executes through ACP (ADR-0002) via the acp-xtb-path-adapter entry.

entries.notes: ORCA 6.1 manual-level claims (design 9.1): native B/A/D scan up to 3 coordinates; Simul_Scan syntax exists at manual level; custom B point lists exist at manual level. max_scan_coordinates=3 is the design/config native-scan bound — the contracts-surface <=4 is NOT executable capability. Per-point orchestration and every mode here are unprobed: probe_receipts empty, effective disabled until version smokes are recorded.

Current PES2TS-to-ACP projection reality (integration/acp/adapter.py:178-213): single uniform B distance scan only; multi-coordinate rejected (adapter.py:212-213); non-uniform point lists rejected (adapter.py:208-211); point window 3..101. Empty method_element_coverage: the adapter is a transparent method projector, not an element gate. This entry is code-observed, not smoke-probed; probe_receipts stay empty.

ORCA invoking xTB as the electronic-structure method — registered SEPARATELY from native xtb-native-path (design 9.1: independent xTB and ORCA-calling-xTB must not share constraint semantics). Constraint semantics follow ORCA constrained-scan machinery, never xTB PATH metadynamics. Unprobed: probe_receipts empty.

Native GFN2-xTB PATH metadynamics, executed through ACP (ADR-0002; adapter repointed from g2-path-runner to acp, see acp-xtb-path-adapter). PATH mode only; NO native scan coordinates (max_scan_coordinates=0, coordinate_kinds empty). Constraint support all false: metadynamics is not constrained scanning and must never inherit ORCA constraint semantics. point_limits kept for schema uniformity only; PATH image count follows the frozen path_recipe, not scan points. Unprobed: probe_receipts empty — capability stays unknown until a real ACP xTB-path smoke receipt exists.

Legacy-named G2 xTB PATH adapter entry, repointed to acp per ADR-0002 (execution no longer runs the local g2-path-runner; xTB PATH executes through ACP). Projects endpoint geometries plus the frozen path_recipe; no scan-coordinate projection; no ORCA constraint machinery. Empty method_element_coverage (transparent projector). See acp-xtb-path-adapter for the canonical ACP-executed XTB_PATH adapter record. Unprobed: probe_receipts empty.

ACP-executed XTB_PATH method adapter (ADR-0002): the planning plane dispatches method_kind=XTB_PATH path candidates here as a compiled recipe (path_recipe assembly/recipe parameters owned by PES2TS; ACP XtbPathSearch executes faithfully, validates but supplies no defaults). PATH mode only; no native scan coordinates; constraint semantics all false. Transparent projector: empty method_element_coverage. Honest initial state: probe_receipts empty — capability_check/effective enablement stays unknown (never silently enabled) until a real captured ACP version/executable sha smoke receipt is recorded against this entry.

Deployment baseline: declares intent for both project stacks (ORCA/ACP single-distance scan and xTB PATH via ACP per ADR-0002); engine_version is the TARGET version, not a measured one. probe_receipts empty on every shipped layer: unprobed combinations can never yield ready. Gated smoke tasks record pass/fail receipts here (and on the matching engine/adapter entries) before any mode becomes enabled.
